fields.Name: Mara Venn
fields.Description: a one-eyed courier who knows every shortcut, refuses to carry weapons, and is secretly transporting a dragon egg.

fields.Name: Brother Caldus
fields.Description: a cheerful healer whose miracles work but whose god officially denies knowing him.

fields.Name: Iri Quickchalk
fields.Description: a goblin cartographer who maps rumors rather than roads and becomes offended when either proves inaccurate.

fields.Name: Lady Seraphine Vale
fields.Description: an impeccably polite noble funding both sides of a rebellion to minimize civilian casualties.

fields.Name: Tomas Rook
fields.Description: a retired monster hunter who now runs a bakery and recognizes the party's flour as mimic dust.

fields.Name: Nella Brass
fields.Description: a young runesmith capable of brilliant work only while someone tells her a completely new story.

fields.Name: Captain Orro Flint
fields.Description: a river-orc guard who loves procedure, competitive poetry, and arresting corrupt superiors.

fields.Name: Velvet
fields.Description: a masked information broker who accepts embarrassing truths as payment and never asks for money.

fields.Name: Old Fen
fields.Description: a shepherd whose sheep predict the weather, danger, and occasionally political assassinations.

fields.Name: Professor Holloway
fields.Description: a spectral historian possessing their own skeleton to continue field research.

fields.Name: Kesh of Seven Knives
fields.Description: an intimidating mercenary who uses six knives for cooking and fears drawing the seventh.

fields.Name: Pella Sunward
fields.Description: a relentlessly optimistic paladin whose holy order was invented during a tavern argument.

fields.Name: Dorrin Slate
fields.Description: a dwarven appraiser who can identify any artifact but compulsively undervalues objects he personally likes.

fields.Name: Mina Thrice-Lost
fields.Description: an explorer who has escaped the same impossible ruin three times and desperately wants to return.

fields.Name: Constable Reed
fields.Description: an honest village officer overwhelmed by crimes involving magic that local law does not acknowledge.

fields.Name: Sable-of-the-Reeds
fields.Description: a marshscale diplomat who pauses for minutes before every answer and never wastes a word.

fields.Name: King Pip IX
fields.Description: a self-proclaimed rat monarch commanding an excellent spy network beneath the capital.

fields.Name: Auntie Ember
fields.Description: an elderly ashborn innkeeper who gives free rooms to adventurers and invoices them later in favors.

fields.Name: Elias North
fields.Description: a charming thief who steals only keys and has no idea what half of them open.

fields.Name: Juniper Wake
fields.Description: a botanist slowly turning into a tree and treating the transformation as a fascinating inconvenience.

fields.Name: The Gray Witness
fields.Description: a silent armored figure appearing near historic events and sketching everyone present.

fields.Name: Nox Bellweather
fields.Description: a fortune-teller whose false predictions are comforting and whose true ones sound absurd.

fields.Name: Rill
fields.Description: a tidekin salvager carrying love letters recovered from wrecks and trying to deliver each one.

fields.Name: Magistrate Odo Penn
fields.Description: a bureaucrat whose enchanted stamp makes ridiculous temporary laws physically real.

fields.Name: Vexa Coil
fields.Description: an alchemist selling reliable potions in reused bottles with dangerously incorrect labels.

fields.Name: Sir Candlewick
fields.Description: a tiny animated suit of armor searching for a person large enough to be its squire.

fields.Name: Hara Moonclaw
fields.Description: a bounty hunter who always offers targets one fair chance to explain themselves.

fields.Name: Merrit Glass
fields.Description: a nervous royal impersonator who has been ruling more competently than the missing monarch.

fields.Name: Sister Quiet
fields.Description: a priest who took a vow of silence and employs three talkative ravens as theological assistants.

fields.Name: Bramble Jack
fields.Description: a friendly bandit leader who insists every robbery include refreshments and a written customer survey.
